messages:
anya: Heads-up: dashboards are blowing up when we show per-key project attribution. Need a sampling pattern that preserves attribution for debugging but keeps cardinality down.
devin: Could do a two-tier sampler: always keep N events/day per key (to guarantee visibility for low-volume keys) + probabilistic sampling for hot keys.
rachel: Agree. Also we should record both origin_key_id and a compact eff_id_hash for delegated calls so we can attribute without storing long strings.
anya: Important: sampled telemetry must never influence quota enforcement. Enforcement path uses auth-resolver counts.
devin: UX: add a small inline note on the key/activity view: "Metrics are sampled; billing uses authoritative counters." Option to opt-in to include delegated identities (disable by default).
rachel: Rollout plan: stage A staging deploy with sampler + eff_id_hash for top 5k keys, retention 30 days. Stage B expand to 20k and evaluate cost.
ops-bot: deploy: telemetry-sampler@staging -> v0.0.7 by ci/cd at 2026-03-22T19:01:02Z
anya: Action items: devin build sampler (PR by Wed), rachel add eff_id_hashing lib + docs, I'll coordinate with billing on retention.
anya: Cool, let's avoid adding more filters in console; keep links to filtered logs instead.
